_comment: Minimal fixture for the HC32F460 boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit (SYSREG storeback returns 0 on CMU_CKSWR.CKSW which routes SystemCoreClockUpdate through the internal-HRC branch and avoids the PLL setup path entirely; EFM HRC_FREQ_MON returns 0 which selects the HRC_20MHz_VALUE branch) and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the USART1 pty Renode exposes (HC32F460_USART C# model loaded via `i @hc32f460_uart.cs` before LoadPlatformDescription).
